label: Presence of required object
requirement_assertion: A required object is present within the target.
non_detection_meaning: Non-detection may indicate absence or lack of observability; the two are separated by the detectability calculation.

label: Spatial completeness
requirement_assertion: A required condition holds over the full extent of the target.
non_detection_meaning: Non-detection says nothing about the unobserved portion; coverage fixes how much of the target was observable.

label: Component integrity
requirement_assertion: All required components of an assembly are present and correctly configured.
non_detection_meaning: Sufficiency is limited by the least observable component, not by their combination.

label: Verified absence
requirement_assertion: A prohibited object or condition is absent.
non_detection_meaning: Non-detection is evidence of absence only in proportion to the probability that the object would have been detected had it been present.

label: Geometric conformance
requirement_assertion: A measured geometric relationship conforms to the approved design.
non_detection_meaning: Not settleable by object detection; requires measurement of the as-built against the model.

label: Documentary conformance
requirement_assertion: A required certificate, declaration or approval exists and is valid.
non_detection_meaning: Not settleable from site imagery; requires documentary verification.

label: Material-test conformance
requirement_assertion: A laboratory or in-situ test result satisfies the specified limit.
non_detection_meaning: Not settleable from site imagery; requires the corresponding test result.
